subject: Performance spike and proposed service makeup for Apex Analytics
messages:
From: Kyle Barnes <kyle@apexanalytics.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Apex Analytics Legal <contracts@apexanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T16:12:00Z
Subject: Performance spike: production latency & error increase (Apex Analytics)

Hi Dev,

We're seeing a sharp regression in production starting ~2027-05-09 02:00 UTC: 95th-p latency for our inference calls jumped from ~120ms to ~850ms and 5xx rate increased to ~3.4% for our peak tenant. Throughput is also throttling intermittently; this is impacting customer-facing features.

This is a high-severity impact for us — we went into degraded mode for parts of the morning and had to route traffic to fallbacks. Can you escalate to execs and provide a proposed remediation and commercial makeup? We need:
- Immediate mitigation ETA and timeline for RCA
- Proposed credits or contract remediation for the period of impact
- A single point of contact for procurement/legal coordination

Attached is a summary of traces and error counts for the last 48h.

Thanks,
Kyle
Head of Platform Engineering
Apex Analytics

[attachment: log_summary.csv (CSV, 120KB)]

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Barnes <kyle@apexanalytics.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Performance spike: production latency & error increase (Apex Analytics)

Hi Kyle — thanks for flagging this and for the logs. I’m really sorry for the customer impact here. We’ve opened a P1 and our Infra team is on it now. Immediate next steps:

1) Mitigation: we’ve pushed a safe fallback route to reduce tail latency while we diagnose (target: reduction in 95th-p within 2 hours).
2) RCA + timeline: prelim RCA estimate within 24 hours, full report within 72 hours.
3) Commercial: working with finance/ops to propose a makeup/credit and a contract amendment for the affected window — will route through you and Apex legal.

I’ve looped in Vivek (Revenue & Customer Ops) and Lauren (Customer Success lead) to coordinate credits and communications. I’ll update you in this thread with a draft proposal by end of day tomorrow.

Apologies again — I’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth.

Best,
Dev Patel
Director, Account Success
Redwood Inference

[attachment: error_snapshot.png (PNG, 1.2MB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T02:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Performance spike — proposed makeup methodology (internal)

Thanks for the quick catch, team. For commercial remediation I propose a two-part offer to balance customer goodwill and precedent:

A) One-time credit: pro-rated committed monthly reservation for the impacted SLO window + 25% uplift to account for business disruption. Using Apex committed monthly of $172,800, pro-rate for the 36-hour impact window => $8,640 base credit; with 25% uplift => $10,800.

B) Service extension: one additional month of Dedicated priority support (adds business value without direct cash outlay).

Rationale: avoids setting an open cash precedent while showing meaningful makeup. If customer insists on larger cash, we can escalate to VP Commercial for approval; Rafael, can you confirm if Legal can accept a contract amendment (DocuSign) with these terms? Also need finance to confirm the credit posting workflow and timing.

If legal OK, we should propose the amendment and an executive call — Kyle has been explicit they want exec attention, so suggest joining: Vivek + Dev + Apex CTO.

— Vivek

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Barnes <kyle@apexanalytics.com>
Cc: Apex Analytics Legal <contracts@apexanalytics.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:22:00Z
Subject: Proposed service makeup for Apex Analytics (proposal & next steps)

Kyle — thank you for your patience. Per our internal review and in the spirit of making this right, Redwood is proposing the following: 

1) One-time credit: $10,800 applied to your next billing cycle. This represents the pro-rated committed monthly amount for the 36-hour impact window plus a 25% uplift to account for disruption.

2) Service extension: one complimentary month of Dedicated priority support, including a technical review session with our Infra team to review mitigation and future hardening steps.

3) Contract amendment: we’ve prepared a short amendment (attached) that documents the makeup and the mutual action plan (RCA delivery timelines, change freezes for a defined window, and an SLA update for routing fallbacks). If acceptable, please sign via DocuSign at: https://app.docusign.com/amendment/APEX-459-makeup

4) Executive call: we can arrange an executive alignment call this week (Vivek, Dev, and Apex CTO / Kyle). Proposed times: 2027-05-13 16:00 UTC or 2027-05-14 09:00 UTC — reply with preferred slot.

We’ve included Apex legal on the amendment packet for review. If Apex prefers a different commercial form (cash instead of credit), please advise and I’ll route to our VP Commercial.

Best regards,
Dev Patel
Director, Account Success
Redwood Inference

[attachment: amendment_draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Kyle Barnes <kyle@apexanalytics.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Apex Analytics Procurement <procurement@apexanalytics.com>, Apex Analytics Legal <contracts@apexanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T09:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed service makeup for Apex Analytics (proposal & next steps)

Dev / Vivek — thanks for the quick, concrete proposal and for involving legal. Apex accepts the proposed makeup (credit of $10,800 + one-month Dedicated support extension). Procurement will complete the DocuSign approval and countersign; I’ve looped procurement on this thread.

Please schedule the exec alignment call for 2027-05-13 16:00 UTC — our CTO will join. Kyle
Head of Platform Engineering
Apex Analytics
